name: Career and Technical Programs 2027-28 Application
org: Somerset County Vocational and Technical High Schools
what_you_do: Study a career and technical program in high school, such as carpentry, plumbing, welding, culinary arts, computer science, biomedical, finance, theater or health medical sciences.
who_can_apply: Students applying for the 2027-28 school year. The district serves students from Somerset and neighboring counties. Some programs (biomedical, finance, HVACR, global business) are shared-time only.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the admissions page. An admissions test may be required (see the CTE Admissions Testing page). Call Pupil Services at 908-526-8900 ext. 7250 or 7243.
notes: Health and medical sciences academy has its own admission page and phone, 908-526-8900 ext. 7148. Enrolled students can join a paid Cooperative Education job placement. That is not open to outside teens.
